## Definition Of Done

- [ ] **Test Cases Pass:** All applicable test cases for this user story executed successfully with no failures. Record any justified manual-only or blocked case in Operational Notes.
- [ ] **Unit Tests Pass:** All relevant unit tests pass with no failures.
- [ ] **Peer Review Complete:** At least one other team member reviewed and approved the code.
- [ ] **UI Guidelines Satisfied:** If this change affects the user interface, it follows the team's established UI/UX guidelines and design standards.
- [ ] **Product Owner Accepts:** The Product Owner reviewed and accepted the work as meeting the requirements.

Work is not complete until every applicable Definition of Done criterion is satisfied. Partial completion must be recorded as a blocker or follow-up rather than represented as done.
